dataset.source: real DSH session user messages, manually labeled to 36 real archive records
dataset.split: positive records disjoint from train for val (4 val records)

interpretation: On real queries with record-disjoint validation, the learned selector does not beat the rule materializer; the earlier 0.963 templated split was overly optimistic (shared records/templates). This is a negative but important generalization result.
caveats: Only 4 real-query validation groups; statistically weak.
Manual labels from session queries; noisy.
Cross-encoder trained on very few real queries; overfits.
No production integration; rule materializer remains default.
